items.title: Strong El Nino 'adding fuel to a planet already on fire', warns UN chief
items.standfirst: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned on Friday that a strengthening El Niño is intensifying an already worsening climate crisis, saying the weather phenomenon is "adding fuel to a planet already on fire" and could drive record-breaking global temperatures.
items.content: UN Secretary-General António Guterres warned on Friday that a strengthening El Niño is intensifying an already worsening climate crisis, saying the weather phenomenon is "adding fuel to a planet already on fire" and could drive record-breaking global temperatures.

items.title: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean’s Rein Me In breaks 73-year record to become longest-running UK No 1 single
items.standfirst: Duetting stars surpass record set in 1953, when crooner Frankie Laine hit the top with I BelieveSam Fender and Olivia Dean have scored the longest running UK No 1 single in history with Rein Me In, beating a record that has stood since 1953.Back then, the UK singles chart had been running for less than a year and contained just 12 songs when I Believe, a bombastic ballad by US crooner Frankie Laine, hit No 1 and spent a total of 18 weeks on the chart. items.title: How Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's Rein Me In broke the UK's singles chart record
items.standfirst: The duet has spent 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the charts, breaking a 73-year-old record.
